email.subject: Your take on new-age tech schools
email.body:
Hi Saumya,

Your video on the truth about new-age tech schools in India was refreshingly honest, and the comments show how many grads are trying to figure out who to trust.

We run DataLaunch, a 12-week data science bootcamp for fresh CS grads moving into AI/ML. If a student doesn't get a job, we refund their tuition, so we only win when they do.

Would you be open to exploring a collaboration that fits how you talk to your audience?

Best,
The DataLaunch team
